verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents a GraphQL Storefront API for going fully headless, with its own overview page. It also offers Catalyst, a first-party Next.js framework marketed for headless storefronts, so both paths in the story are covered first-party. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building a headless storefront, and in-pack detail on what the Storefront API covers (e.g., cart/checkout/customer operations); the evidence is mostly page titles and taglines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a fully custom headless storefront on a documented storefront API or first-party frontend framework

citations.quote: Build with Catalyst (Next.js), customize Stencil themes, or go fully headless with the GraphQL Storefront API.
